name: Amazon Ancient Ruins
notes: V0.6.3 replaces generic box presentation for the exact 30149 two-seat vehicle tub and exact 30147 grille with recognizable molded geometry while keeping their authoritative transforms unchanged.

The 33129 boat hull now renders as an open hull with floor, gunwales, stern and tapered bow instead of a box/cone block, and the whole boat assembly is shifted together to the corrected river datum at render time.
Exact coverage remains 63/420 because this phase improves presentation fidelity rather than promoting unresolved body pieces.
V0.6.2 keeps the physical build surface at y=0.35 while the molded pits and river descend below it; this preserves existing attachment heights while giving the raised baseplate real depth.
The corrected 16x4 rope bridge and exact gateway local geometry remain mutually aligned.

The off-road car is anchored by exact chassis, axle plates, wheel hubs, tires, seat tub and grille; remaining body plates/windows/details stay quarantined until their step-specific positions are resolved.
The molded 30271px1 baseplate is one real inventory part plus render-only terrain helpers; helpers consume zero inventory slots.
The full-set solver remains evidence-gated: CAD can classify and locate candidates but cannot raise exact coverage without manual provenance.
World-space convention: one horizontal unit equals one LEGO stud pitch; one brick height is 1.2 world units.
